decisions: Named rearmed_swings.py, not the roster's swing_schedule.py: step 1 landed src/calculator/fight/autos/swing_schedule.py ("When auto attacks land"), and a second swing_schedule.py would leave the fight step importing a module of its own name. This one holds the declared re-ratings of the holder's own attack stream, which is what a rearmed swing is.

DecayingStackRamp and RearmedWindow move with SwingSchedule. They are the two records it merges and its two fields, so leaving them behind is a back-edge; the residue's resolve_slots builds them and reads them back.
resolve_slots and ChargedStrikeSlots stay: ChargedStrikeSlots is the family's resolved shape and SwingSchedule is one of its five fields.

modules.docstring: When a rearmed swing lands, and the two re-ratings one attack stream merges.
